claim_boundary: Degrees per second are gyroscope units; neither fitted sigma nor tau transfers to the Worldlaw pendulum position instrument. Missing clocks, failed held-out fit, negative estimates, or unknown dependence preclude physical calibration.
clock: Preserve source-native samples, no resampling or interpolation. Infer sample period and any fixed per-sensor integer alignment only from training recordings. Apply the fixed mapping to validation/test; never align using held-out gyroscope outcomes.
common_mode_boundary: Pair differences annihilate shared error. A common-mode control may retain the same contrast scores; that is a demonstrated failure of absolute identification, never evidence of calibrated noise.
conditional_qualification: Positive per-sensor variance estimates; absolute mean lag-zero variance ratio error <= 0.25 for every pair; zero covariance residual inside the simultaneous 95 percent bootstrap band; no absolute calibration claim from contrasts alone.
estimator: Four-sensor least-squares over all six pair-difference covariances; also report all triplet estimates and six-pair reconstruction residuals. Do not clip a negative estimate into evidence for identification.
fit: Fit nonnegative coefficients on training only; OU families share a 257-point log tau grid from half a training sample period to 10 seconds and the same fixed covariance coordinates. No tuning after untouched test is opened.
lags: Integer lags 0 through 24 plus nearest native lags to 0.5, 1.0 and 2.0 seconds; deduplicate.
negative_controls: One sensor shifted by nearest native lag to 0.1 second after alignment
Replace one Z channel with its source X channel
Duplicate one physical sensor under a false second identity
Add identical seeded colored common-mode error to every sensor
partition_rule: SHA256 of compact sorted-key JSON mapping decimal sensor ID to uncompressed member SHA256; sort by (recording SHA256, recording name); first 9 train, next 4 validation, last 4 untouched test.
primary_metric: Mean per-pair squared covariance prediction error across the fixed lags, normalized by squared held-out lag-zero pair variance, with recording-level results and equal-recording aggregate.
prior_protocol: F4 taskboard message 161006; physical covariance identification after Worldlaw PR 642
question: Do native simultaneous same-axis gyroscope contrasts support a transferable stationary independent-sensor covariance model on unseen recordings?
selection: All 17 Car_Exp/Conf_1 Bottom recordings and their four DOT sensors; selection uses directory metadata only.
training_calibration: Prescribed first 30 seconds only for clock diagnostics and constant bias; any learned orientation/scale mapping fits training only and is reported as a separate secondary representation.
uncertainty: 95 percent hierarchical recording/20-second contiguous-block bootstrap, 2000 fixed-seed draws; no per-block demeaning. Also report simultaneous covariance residual bands.
